verdict.rationale: Cactus documents downloading the resulting fine-tuned models and the base model (docs-10, docs-1). An open-source package supports local fine-tuning with your own hardware and data, and an offline evaluator scores the same way the platform does, so a user can keep artifacts and run without the hosted platform (docs-2, docs-12). There is no documented account-wide export covering generated training data, uploads, tool schemas and run history, and model export formats are not stated to be open. Missing for 10: a documented complete data export or takeout, retrieval of generated training datasets, explicit open file formats for exported models and data, account deletion or offboarding docs, and independent corroboration.
